acceptance_predicates.description: Visual fixtures cover every application route and all meaningful visual states.
Resize preserves valid focus, selection, step, and contextual-help state across supported dimensions.
Color/Unicode loss does not erase selection, focus, current-step, warning, or error meaning.
CI rejects drift among renderer, formal model, inventory/ownership, help, keybindings, and snapshot fixtures.

definition_of_done: Visual fidelity and accessibility regressions fail deterministically before user-facing breakage ships.

outputs.description: Route/resize/capability/keyboard parity suite and CI gate.

gates.description: Visual snapshots, formal model, ownership, help, accessibility, and resize checks are required CI.
